alerts.summary: The publish_actions permission was deprecated; apps that already had it kept it until 1 August 2018, and Meta points to the Share dialogs instead.
alerts.quote: The publish_actions permission will be deprecated.

alerts.summary: Graph API v3.0 deprecated the rsvp_event and user_managed_groups permissions.
alerts.quote: The rsvp_event and user_managed_groups permissions are deprecated.

alerts.summary: Graph API v7.0 split manage_pages into four pages_* permissions; it was fully deprecated in May 2022.
alerts.quote: The manage_pages and publish_pages permissions will be fully deprecated in May of 2022.

alerts.summary: Graph API v7.0 split publish_pages into pages_manage_posts and pages_manage_engagement, on the same timeline as manage_pages.
alerts.quote: The publish_pages permission has been deprecated and replaced with 2 new permissions:

alerts.summary: With every Page on the new Pages experience, Page Insights metrics including these were removed on 14 March 2024; the changelog entry lists about 85 such metrics, and only these four are matched here.
alerts.quote: We are providing a 90-day notice to developers that these deprecations will be implemented on March 14, 2024,

alerts.summary: The Instagram Basic Display API stopped working on 4 December 2024 and every request to it fails; Meta points business and creator use cases to the Instagram API with Instagram Login or with Facebook Login.
alerts.quote: Starting on December 4th, 2024, Instagram Basic Display API will no longer be available.

alerts.summary: The Instagram API with Instagram Login renamed its four scope values to instagram_business_* names, one to one in this order, and retired the old values on 27 January 2025.
alerts.quote: Please note that the old scope values will be deprecated on January 27, 2025.

alerts.summary: Meta oEmbed Read replaced the oEmbed Read feature on 3 November 2025, across all versions: author_name, author_url and the thumbnail fields left the response for Facebook posts, Facebook videos and Instagram posts.
alerts.quote: The current oEmbed Read feature will be deprecated on November 3, 2025.

alerts.summary: On 15 November 2025 these Page Insights metrics were removed for every API version; the changelog gives alternatives for some, such as page_follows and page_media_view.
alerts.quote: On November 15, 2025, a number of the Page Insights metrics will be deprecated for all API versions.
